Hadith.1629 - Sama'ah narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:
I asked him about Zakat: "Is it permissible for a man who owns a house and a servant to accept Zakat?"
Imam (as) replied: "Yes, unless his house is a source of income (dar ghallah) from which he receives enough income to suffice himself and his dependents.
If the income from it does not suffice for their food, clothing, and needs without extravagance, then it is permissible for him to accept Zakat.
However, if its income suffices them, then it is not permissible."
